title: Build Whisper's log-mel front end
brief: Compress a mel power matrix the way Whisper does, pad a clip to 30 seconds, and chain the power spectrogram, the filterbank, and the compression into Whisper's exact log-mel features.
hints: Clamp first, then take the log: np.log10(np.maximum(mel_power, 1e-10)). The clamp keeps zero powers from becoming minus infinity.
Whisper's floor is log_spec.max() - 8.0 over the whole matrix, not per frame: np.maximum(log_spec, log_spec.max() - 8.0).
np.pad(audio, (0, length - len(audio))) adds zeros at the end; slice audio[:length] when the clip is already long enough.
A centered STFT of N samples with hop 160 has 1 + N // 160 frames. Whisper keeps N // 160 of them: slice [:, :-1].
